Early Voting In Person

 

Early Voting Centers (In-Person Absentee Voting) are available to all City of Milwaukee Residents, opening the Tuesday two weeks prior to an election and closing the Sunday before Election Day.  Please review each location's hours in detail.

Only City of Milwaukee citizens can vote at our Early Voting Centers. City of Milwaukee voters can visit any location regardless of where they live in the city.  Voters may also register to vote, view a sample ballot, and/or drop off their absentee ballot during scheduled hours.

Established in 1846, the City of Milwaukee is home to nearly 600,000 residents and is a city built on water with over 10 miles of lakefront shoreline. With three rivers and a Great Lake, water plays a key role in the city’s history, identity, and economy.
